items.t: Municipality: City of Maple Ridge. The City publishes no boundary for this name and its neighbourhood list names Albion/Kanaka, Port Hammond, Port Haney, Ruskin, Silver Valley, Thornhill, Town Centre, Webster's Corners, Whonnock and Yennadon — there is no City neighbourhood called "North" or "North Maple Ridge"; the guide page itself states "North Maple Ridge is an MLS® sub-area name.

Working geography (guide page only, never a boundary citation): roughly 224 Street to 240 Street, north of Dewdney Trunk Road and the Town Centre, up to and across the Alouette River into Silver Valley. Main roads: Dewdney Trunk Road along the south edge; 232 Street and 240 Street north–south. Nearby areas: Town Centre to the south, Silver Valley to the north (overlapping this page's own scope), Albion/Kanaka to the east, and West Central / East Central to the southwest and south.

Maple Ridge community medians (sub-area medians are not published: UNVERIFIED at sub-area level): detached $1,131,000; attached $525,000, $432/sq ft, 94% sale-to-list, 49 days on market. Maple Ridge IS a SnapStats-covered community and these figures are cited only as the report states them.
Where the condo stock concentrates: nowhere in apartment form — there is no verified apartment-condo building anywhere in this page's scope.

SD42 runs K–7 elementary and 8–12 secondary, with no middle-school tier — the guide page lists Thomas Haney Secondary as "7–12," which conflicts with that structure and is flagged in. Because no official sub-area boundary exists, whether every named school sits inside the board sub-area is UNVERIFIED. Catchments are address-based through the SD42 School Locator; no locator result for an address in this scope was run, so the catchment school for any specific address is UNVERIFIED.
West Coast Express: Maple Meadows Station and Port Haney Station serve Maple Ridge on weekdays between Waterfront and Mission City; neither station is inside this scope.

Floodplain and ALR: the Alouette River floodplain crosses this ground; the Fraser River flood construction level is 6.7 m geodetic (including freeboard), no habitable floor space may sit below that level on affected lots, and rental accommodation (suites) is prohibited on floodplain properties under Zoning Bylaw s. 402.8(h). The City describes Yennadon as an active agricultural production area, but ALR status is per-parcel. Which lots are affected: UNVERIFIED per parcel.

items.t: Pad-rent parks (MHPTA): no manufactured-home park inside this scope was verified; where a Maple Ridge park home is bought instead of a strata unit, pad rent may rise at most once every 12 months, on 3 full months' notice, by no more than the yearly limit plus a proportional amount — 2026 = 2.3% plus proportional, 2027 = 2.2% plus proportional. No pad-rent dollar figure is published here.

blocks.text: Good to know about North Maple Ridge Guide

items.t: The page's name has no official existence. "North Maple Ridge" appears in no City neighbourhood list and no City boundary document — the City names for this ground are Silver Valley and Yennadon, and searches run under only the page name miss City documents, plans and the Silver Valley Area Plan filed under those names.
A zero-listing month here is a mapping artifact, not a market signal.

7781-2021) as a live-page error, on an earlier contrary research reading that City sources showed only initial readings at the end of 2025. The City's own record states the opposite: following the January 20, 2026 public hearing, Bylaw No. 7781-2021 was given third reading and adopted at the January 27, 2026 Regular Council Meeting (City news release February 4, 2026).

(2) Thomas Haney Secondary is listed as "7–12," conflicting with SD42's K–7 / 8–12 structure. (3) The guide page's Golden Ears Provincial Park, Maple Ridge Park facility and Silver Valley trail-network statements were recorded as site copy only, UNVERIFIED against an official source in the research pass — do not quote them as verified fact.

The one seniors complex in scope is mislabelled in its own directory. The Co-operative Housing Federation of BC's listing for Haney Pioneer Village describes an 84-unit complex "for active seniors aged 60+" and simultaneously carries a "55+" tag — a buyer filtering for 55+ strata condos can land on a 60+ co-op that sells no strata title at all.
Maple Ridge's OCP citation is unsettled in current sources.

The river is the real boundary in this scope. The Alouette River splits the page's ground: suburban/acreage Yennadon to the south, the planned Silver Valley townhome-and-house community to the north, with the floodplain crossing both — flood construction level, suite prohibitions on floodplain lots and per-parcel ALR status are address-level checks, not area-level assumptions.

No recreation centre or library branch sits inside this scope. The Maple Ridge Leisure Centre (11925 Haney Place) and Maple Ridge Public Library (130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road) are in the Town Centre to the south; the serving hospital is Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, with the Urgent and Primary Care Centre at 121 – 11900 Haney Place, open 7 days a week, 9:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. In-scope recreation is Maple Ridge Park, 13180 232 Street, on the South Alouette River in Yennadon, plus Kanaka Creek Regional Park at the east side.

What trades here

items.t: Fee-simple lots are the default form: Urban-fringe houses sit under RS-1 (Single Detached Residential), Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019 s. 605 — minimum lot area 668.0 m², minimum lot width 18.0 m, minimum lot depth 27.0 m, maximum lot coverage 40%. The rural and agricultural zones covering the acreage side carry much larger minimums in the same schedule: A-1 2.0 ha, A-2 4.0 ha, A-3 8.0 ha, RS-2 0.4 ha, RS-3 0.8 ha or 2.0 ha depending on the zone text.

Bare-land strata: none verified — count 0: The strata stock that exists here is built townhouse strata (below), which is not bare-land strata and must never be presented as lot stock. Where a bare-land strata lot did exist, the buyer would own the lot as a strata lot: strata fees and bylaws apply to the lot itself, and the purchase runs on a Form B (SPA s.
: Its one presale collection, Hillside Homes (133 Avenue & Rock Ridge Drive, Silver Valley), is presale-only there, never folded into its completed total, and is not a lot offering.
: It also sits on Northwest ground (207A Street), west of this page's 224–240 Street scope.

A plan designation is not an approval and no development site is listed as inventory here.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in North Maple Ridge

items.t: ALR block — full form (Yennadon farm ground): subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval, and ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Information Bulletin 09, s. 6; Strata Property Act, s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act, s. 21(1)). Residence caps: one principal residence per parcel, maximum 500 m²; a secondary suite only inside the principal residence; one additional residence capped at 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less and 186 m² on parcels over 40 ha. Farm class (BC Assessment) in full three-tier form: $2,500 of gross farm income at 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 plus 5% of the actual value of the area over 4 ha above that; $10,000 under 0.8 ha — applications by October 31.

It is tenure stock, never lot stock.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in North Maple Ridge?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in North Maple Ridge?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in North Maple Ridge?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in North Maple Ridge?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Is "North Maple Ridge" the same as "Northeast"?
Can I rent out a townhome here long-term?
faq.a: Yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC; Brighton's building record in any case records rentals as allowed. Short-term rentals can still be restricted; check the registered bylaws on the Form B.

faq.q: Is Haney Pioneer Village a 55+ condo I can buy?
faq.a: No on both counts. It is an 84-unit housing co-operative at 11830 230 Street for independent seniors aged 60+ — NEVER 55+ — you buy co-op shares and occupancy, not a strata lot, there is no Form B, and a co-op directory page tagging it "55+" is contradicted by the co-op's own 60+ description.

Assignment is by home address through the SD42 School Locator, and no catchment is asserted here without a locator run. Note the guide page's "7–12" line for Thomas Haney conflicts with SD42's 8–12 secondary structure.

faq.q: What does the Silver Valley Area Plan update change for the north part?
faq.a: The update was adopted November 25, 2025 and sets the designations for the ground north of the Alouette River — a lot's plan designation, not just its current house, drives its long-term value. No equivalent plan exists for "North Maple Ridge" as a whole.

faq.q: Are there any apartment condos in North Maple Ridge?
faq.a: None verified, on either reading of the area. A buyer searching "North Maple Ridge condos" is shopping townhouses north of the Alouette River or acreages south of it.

faq.q: How many townhouse complexes are there, and where?
faq.a: Three verified completed complexes, all strata, all in the Silver Valley portion north of the Alouette River: Brighton (13819 232 Street, 145 units, 2011), Archstone Rockridge (13260 236 Street, year UNCONFIRMED 2017–2018) and Windfall (23183 136 Avenue, 54 units, 2023). Hillside Homes is a presale collection only in the sources checked, never counted with completed stock.

faq.q: Is "North Maple Ridge" the same as "Northeast"?
faq.a: No. Do not use Northeast figures for this page.
